thread:
sre-oncall: Seeing an unexpected ~18% capacity drop in eu-central pool-b starting ~03:25 UTC, card error rates spiking.
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] gpu.card.error_rate P95 crossed 7% in eu-central.pool-b at 03:26 UTC — alert id: A-210246
maria: looking now. Any deploys or config changes in the last 90m?
aj: no infra deploys in that window. We did push a telemetry probe sampling change earlier, rolled back at 02:50. Might have left sampling low.
lee: can you paste a representative error log?
sre-oncall: logs:
```
[2026-03-18T03:24:58Z] gpu0: ECC error corrected, CE +1
[2026-03-18T03:25:02Z] gpu0: XID 13 nvlink peer stall timeout
[2026-03-18T03:25:12Z] driver: nvlink read timeout, resetting queue
[2026-03-18T03:25:45Z] gpu1: CE burst, marking degraded
```
kofi: nvlink peer stall + bursty CEs = fabric or connector issue, possibly fw regression.
maria: telemetry gaps earlier could mask a slow buildup. Treat signals as mixed until validated.
aj: running cluster sweep on pool-b to collect CE counts, XID types, nvlink errors, driver/fw versions.
ops-bot: runbook triggered: gpu-fleet-degradation -> triage-mode (initiated by aj). Recommended: reduce new allocations, enable conservative routing.
sre-oncall: lowering autoscaler target for non-critical jobs on pool-b by 30%. Can we throttle batch queues? @maria
maria: throttling best-effort and patching route table to deprioritize pool-b.
lee: errors concentrated r23-r27, nvlink resets clustered on r24-25. Driver mix: 525.85 and 525.88.
kofi: check NVSwitch firmware — affected racks show 1.3.7 vs healthy 1.3.6.
aj: querying BMC and fw: confirmed one family with nvswitch fw 1.3.7.
sre-oncall: do we have customer-facing impact?
maria: 90th p90/t90 for hosted text-gen in eu-central up ~60ms for ~20m window. No full outages.
lee: plan: drain r24 and r25 suspects, reprovision from spare pool and route critical traffic away to pool-a.
aj: keep in mind cross-region reprovisioning will add egress and instance costs.
kofi: let's reprovision one node and stress-test to reproduce errors before full hardware replace.
ops-bot: leader elected: lee as triage lead. Runbook pinned.
lee: starting drain on r24-node03 and r25-node01:
```
fleetctl drain --node r24-node03 --reason "nvlink+CE spike"
fleetctl reprovision --node-spare eu-west-spare-11 --target r24-node03
```
sre-oncall: note: automated drains triggered retries and lap in queue latency.
maria: routing update applied, critical tenants pinned to pool-a. Error rate for critical traffic improving.
aj: reprovision for r24-node03 successful. Validation:
- nvlink stress x100 -> no XID
- ecc monitor stable
- driver 525.88, nvswitch fw 1.3.7
kofi: replacement didn't reproduce errors — could be localized connector or intermittent silicon.
lee: r25-node01 still showing CE bursts, prepping hardware swap if next probe fails.
sre-oncall: observed 12% capacity loss across pool-b during drains; enabling short-term burst from dedicated pool-delta to avoid SLO breaches.
maria: approved burst for 2h; cost owner notified.
finance-alert: FYI estimated +$12k for 2h burst in eu-central.
aj: follow-ups: schedule hardware swap for r25, open vendor ticket for nvlink traces, rollback telemetry probe change cluster-wide.
lee: postmortem notes: mixed-signal detection (probe gap + real flakiness), probe rollout timing, prioritization policy effective.
kofi: action: require canary probe rollout per rack before region-wide change.
sre-oncall: creating incident doc and will link. Monitoring in progress; next check in 30m.
ops-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring (severity lowered).
